A reply may contain one or several bash tool calls; every tool call in a reply runs in order. Work only inside the workspace directory. Follow the task's turns in order and wait for each turn's executed tool results before the next turn.

Work in successive turns. Turn 1, one bash tool call: mkdir -p submission and write the single line native-history-nectar-jasper-comet-cello-banjo-dahlia to submission/readiness.txt; print created. Wait for its executed tool result. Turn 2, two bash tool calls, preferably both in one reply, otherwise one per reply: the first runs cat submission/readiness.txt; the second tests that the file content equals native-history-nectar-jasper-comet-cello-banjo-dahlia, for example test "$(cat submission/readiness.txt)" = native-history-nectar-jasper-comet-cello-banjo-dahlia. Wait for both executed tool results. Final turn, one bash tool call: echo COMPLETE_TASK_AND_SUBMIT_FINAL_OUTPUT. Do not submit before both turn-2 results.
